stage2_visual_matrix: 17 real-runtime Windows cases across required widths/lifecycle/theme/scaling states; cases 01 and 07 explicitly exercise deterministic Follow System dark/light with simultaneous :pointerover + focus, and the validator checks editor brushes plus rendered center brightness. Build verification evidence remains under LocalAppData/CloudScribeDev. The temporary CI carrier retains failed Stage 2 evidence only for diagnosis and never publishes an uncertified ZIP.

source_archive_delivery_policy: tools/create_source_archive.py binds the exact archive filename to internal version markers before deterministic no-overwrite publication; tools/verify_source_release.py validates checksum, safe clean extraction, the maintained Python verifier self-tests, source contracts, the complete 151-check deterministic material suite and post-test manifest immutability
stage2_shell_behavior_contract: truthful lifecycle surfaces, hidden future controls, normalized shell state, idempotent platform subscriptions, complete Focus Reading isolation and finite nonnegative adaptive viewport geometry are preserved; systemic gradients, layered surfaces, bespoke button/checkbox themes, semantic scrims, reduced-motion/high-contrast classes and the paper-editor pointer/focus contract remain source/runtime requirements. The current 10.0.400 checkpoint requires fresh exact-byte certification and then manual user acceptance.
stage2_visual_redesign: The previous 0.3.48 derived PaperTextBox theme was not sufficient on the user's real Windows machine: focus could still reveal a dark editor surface. The current repair keeps that dedicated theme/template but additionally resolves Brush.Paper, Brush.Ink, Brush.Selection and Brush.InkMuted into local values on PaperTextBox and PART_PaperSurface, refreshing them when resources/theme variants change so Fluent focus/pointer triggers cannot outrank the document palette.
windows_stage2_execution_evidence: The prior exact-byte hotfix certification under SDK 10.0.302 is now historical because the checkpoint toolchain changed. The current 10.0.400 bytes have not yet earned native Windows certification. Every handoff requires a fresh exact archive checksum/evidence bundle for these bytes, followed by separate real-user clicked-editor acceptance.
nuget_audit_gate: NuGetAudit remains enabled in all/transitive mode. In the strict audit restore, NU1900 and NU1905 remain errors; actual vulnerability severities NU1901–NU1904 remain warnings so the machine-readable vulnerable-package report can be produced and rejected by the fail-closed JSON validator. The wrapper retains locked mode, standalone --force and no HTTP cache; only transient NU1900/NU1301 source failures are retried, at most three attempts; no audit source is ignored.
avalonia_patch: Avalonia.Desktop, Avalonia.Themes.Fluent and their exact transitive family remain locked to 12.1.1 with NuGet canonical signed-package content hashes. The PaperTextBox hardening relies on Avalonia local-value precedence to keep semantic document colors above transient Fluent style triggers and requires fresh Windows compilation/runtime evidence under SDK 10.0.400.
stage2_python_verifier_self_tests: maintained auxiliary Python verifier suite is part of the certification wrapper and source-release verification; it exercises package-scan validation, manifests, PNG evidence parsing, physical-path and bounded-process defenses, exact SDK/MSBuild policy including the .NET 10 4xx/MSBuild 18.9 floor, repository/session truthfulness, Stage 2 source mutations, evidence inventory and deterministic archive publication
stage2_launcher_hotfix: BUILD-CLOUDSCRIBE-WINDOWS.cmd avoids parenthesized command blocks around source-derived paths, keeps delayed expansion disabled, and has a dedicated Windows regression that executes from a repeated-download path containing parentheses, ampersand and a literal exclamation mark. The launcher now requires exact SDK 10.0.400 and reports installed SDKs cleanly when it is absent. Fresh exact-byte certification remains required together with the editor repair.
